import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    bg=g[0][0]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    obj=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    r0=min(i for i,j,v in obj); r1=max(i for i,j,v in obj)
    c0=min(j for i,j,v in obj); c1=max(j for i,j,v in obj)
    o=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    o=[row[::-1] for row in o]          # horizontal mirror
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    zrows=[i for i in range(H) if any(v==0 for v in g[i])]
    zcols=[j for j in range(W) if any(g[i][j]==0 for i in range(H))]
    zi,zj=min(zrows),min(zcols)
    for k in range(len(o)):
        for m in range(len(o[0])):
            out[zi+k][zj+m]=o[k][m]
